payload.title: Ranking and comparison use only numbers every post has
payload.context: M6 review (#6): clicks need an extra Facebook permission, so scores with clicks favoured Pages and periods that had it; fresh posts and tiny samples were ranked as if comparable; reach was summed although it counts unique people.
payload.rationale: Every ranking, on the Insights page and in the choice of examples for drafting, uses reactions, comments and shares only. A post competes after 48 hours, and nothing is called best or marked as having done well until a channel has five such measured posts. Pillar averages are per post on one channel. Reach is never added up.
payload.consequences: Clicks and reach are shown where given and never ranked. The two minimums are settings without data behind them yet.
